title: easy to iput on mattress, but once again, another encasement that failed the "pee test"
text: easy to iput on mattress, but once again, another encasement that failed the "pee test". this arrived a little bit wrinkle, as if it were used.  i did contact the company and was told to contact amazon for refund or exchange, but i had already placed on mattress for  use.  The first 2 uses, no pee reached mattress, however by the 3rd wash and 3rd use, the pee went through.  NO CLOROX WAS USED IN WASHING (SO NO COATING SHOULD HAVE COME OFF THE ENCASEMENT)

product_metadata.title: LUCID Encasement Mattress Protector - Completely Surrounds Mattress for Waterproof Protection, White, Twin XL
features: Encases the mattress for complete protection from liquids and stains
Deep pocket design accommodates mattresses 6 to 18 inches deep - bottom elastic creates a smooth, secure fit
Thin fabric is quiet, smooth and breathable and will not change the feel of your mattress
100 percent waterproof with watertight zipper and sealing flap
description: The LUCID encasement mattress protector offers quiet, breathable comfort while providing complete protection for your mattress. This 100 percent waterproof protector surrounds the mattress with quiet, breathable fabric for a comfortable and healthy sleep environment. The waterproof barrier allows air to pass for breathable comfort while protecting the mattresses from fluids, spills and stains on all sides. Surface fabric: 100 percent polyester, Backing: 100 percent polyurethane
